card.name: Comma before a source attribution
card.fires_on: The comma (or comma plus closing quote) that ends a factual news or health claim, right where a source such as 'according to the CDC' or 'the DEC said' is likely to follow.

modes.label: Comma before 'according to'
modes.description: A comma after a statistic or factual statement, followed by a named agency or organization as the source.
modes.example: 10 of whom died<<,>> according to the Centers for Disease Control.

modes.label: Comma before 'X said'
modes.description: A comma or comma-plus-quote ending a statement, followed by the speaker or organization that said it.
modes.example: infeasible to implement<<,">> the DEC said.

card.writes: It promotes 'according' and its equivalents in other languages, pushing the model to attribute the claim to a source.
card.plain: It fires at the comma after a fact, when the text is about to name who reported it.
